mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_codef_connection (user_id, organization, business_type, connected_id_encrypted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{organization}, #{businessType}, #{connectedIdEncrypted}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_type = VALUES(business_type), connected_id_encrypted = VALUES(connected_id_encrypted), is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_codef_connection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY organization
